# Metacritic User score paired ablations

2026-11-17. Each intervention was applied temporarily to production code and tested through `SubjectPageRuntime`. No production feature flags or ablation branches were added. The original implementation was restored immediately after each failing run, and the paired test was rerun successfully.

| Mechanism | Fixed input and single intervention | Failing command and observed result | Restored command |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Season-bound audience identity | Chernobyl season 1; accept the otherwise correct review link without checking its `season` query. | `pnpm vitest run tests/runtime/subject-runtime-metacritic-user-score-season.test.tsx -t "keeps the verified Metascore but rejects a User score linked to another season" --reporter=dot` failed: the wrong-season User score appeared, the diagnostic became `rating`, and a snapshot was written. | Same command passed after restoring the season check. |
| Native TBD state | Crew Girl season 1; prefer the test-only normalized embedded `score: 0` probe over the captured visible TBD card. | `pnpm vitest run tests/runtime/subject-runtime-metacritic-user-score-tbd.test.tsx -t "ignores a test-only embedded zero when the captured Crew Girl card is TBD under a controlled target" --reporter=dot` failed: `0/10` with one rating appeared and was cached. | Same command passed after restoring the visible-state check. |
| Native scales and decimal text | Lucky (2026); truncate the User score and display its scale as `/100`. | `pnpm vitest run tests/runtime/subject-runtime-meta-series.test.tsx -t "resolves Lucky from IMDb and follows its Metacritic ID" --reporter=dot` failed: expected `5.0/10`, received `5/100`; Metascore remained `68/100`. | Same command passed after restoring the User score scale and source display text. |
| Partial-failure snapshot protection | Godfather II; write a critic-only result from the response with an invalid User score link. | `pnpm vitest run tests/runtime/subject-runtime-metacritic-user-score-snapshots.test.tsx -t "shows a confirmed critic side after partial failure without replacing or renewing the snapshot" --reporter=dot` failed: the prior dual snapshot was replaced with critic-only data and its `fetchedAt` advanced. | Same command passed after restoring the no-write branch. |

The no-audience-request Crew Girl mapping case remains separate: its real Wikidata fixture resolves to `mapping-missing` and the runtime asserts that no Metacritic page is requested. The controlled target in the TBD ablation test only reaches the parser and is not a production mapping.
